title: Thermal and structural disorder effects on spin-transfer-torque-driven domain wall mobility in CoFeB nanostrips
task: Characterize spin-transfer-torque-driven domain wall dynamics in CoFeB nanostrips under thermal and structural disorder
key_results: 0 K: linear velocity vs. current density; 300 K: velocity saturation and wall deformation; disorder induces creep-like dynamics with intermittent propagation; wall mobility decreases with thickness
comments: Realistic polycrystalline model via Voronoi tessellation identifies competing effects—thermal noise, structural pinning, confinement—crucial for device design.

model_io.model: CoFeB nanostrip with STT-driven domain wall

hypotheses.hypothesis: Thermal fluctuations and structural disorder collectively govern domain wall mobility

comments: Addresses practical trajectory data with realistic discretization; avoids eigenvector computation but scalability to high-dimensional heterogeneity unclear.

title: Triple-Q collinear state with compensated ferrimagnetic nature on frustrated kagome lattice
task: Realize spin-selective band splitting without net magnetization in kagome antiferromagnet

task: Engineer B cells to express fully customizable antibodies with enhanced Fc functions

title: Sleep chart of biological ageing clocks in middle and late life
task: Assess relationship between sleep duration and biological ageing across multiple organ systems and omics technologies
key_results: U-shaped relationship identified with optimal sleep duration 6.4-7.8 h; short (<6 h) and long (>8 h) sleep associated with increased systemic disease risk and all-cause mortality in UK Biobank (n=37-84 years)
comments: Multi-omics integration across 23 biological clocks is comprehensive, but reverse causality between sleep and disease cannot be fully excluded by Mendelian randomization, limiting causal inference.

model_io.model: Sleep Chart: multi-omics ageing clock ensemble

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimal sleep duration minimizes biological age gaps across multiple systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; U-shaped pattern with 6.4-7.8 h optimal range, varying by organ and sex
